ModMetaData.name: Stylized Slave Collars and Headgears
ModMetaData.author: Gerrymon
ModMetaData.description: Add more styles for slave collar and new bridle item, which based on medieval scold's bridle, but have more modern variations in form of styles. It restricts the wearer's talking to 10% and eating to 50% (less than Capacity Deprivation's mouthfold).
